blocks.text: Former “Pinoy Big Brother” housemate Jayson Gainza has urged netizens to be more understanding of the current housemates of “Pinoy Big Brother Collab 3.0,” reminding viewers that what they see inside the house does not reflect the entirety of a person’s character. Gainza, who’s part of the original 2005 “Pinoy Big Brother: Season 1,” in which he finished as the 2nd Big Placer (Runner-up), shared his thoughts during an interview with select media at a racing event organized by a health and wellness clinic in Pampanga on Sunday, Nov. 22. “Ngayon parang kung ano nakikita niyo sa loob, parang ija-judge niyo […]...
